evals.prompt: Use the attached Lumina Base Pack to create a complete 32-bar 4/4 house lighting arrangement at 128 BPM. These creative decisions are confirmed, so proceed without another approval turn: bars 1-8 cool blue foundation, 9-16 magenta buildup with a restrained speed/intensity rise, 17-24 warm amber first drop with clear quadrant call-response, 25-28 blue-violet breakdown, and 29-32 a distinct second-drop/outro hybrid that resolves cleanly. No strobe. Reuse built-in Effects read-only; create the smallest necessary project-local Cues and a project-local Arrangement named `Midnight Geometry 128`. Write a new Project Pack in the requested output directory, never overwrite the input, and include a concise brief/audit/validation transcript.
evals.expected_output: A new, validated UserAssetPack V1 containing an end-to-end 32-bar project-local Arrangement and project-local Cue bindings while preserving every built-in dependency and the input file.
expectations: The output is a schema-, reference-, exact-ref-, and semantic-valid UserAssetPack V1.
The input file hash is unchanged and the output uses a different filename.
Every built-in asset present in both input and output is deeply unchanged; every created or customized Effect is project_local and every created Cue/Arrangement has a non-built-in ID.
`Midnight Geometry 128` uses PPQ 960, 128 BPM, 4/4, 122880 total ticks, legal integer Clip/keyframe ranges, and has no unexplained empty tail.
CueClips reference Cues only and contain no TargetSet field; exact Cue/Effect/Stage/Layout dependencies resolve.
The transcript includes the pack inventory, Effect/Cue audit, confirmed full Arrangement brief, and validation handoff without exposing raw Layer IDs.

evals.expected_output: A new validated Project Pack variant that detects the actual 132 BPM, 64-bar length, 28-bar occupied end and four existing lanes, changes only bars 29-36, and preserves the intentional tail.
expectations: The output is a schema-, reference-, exact-ref-, and semantic-valid UserAssetPack V1 and the input hash is unchanged.
The transcript reports actual 132 BPM despite the name, PPQ 960, 4/4, 64 bars, the source occupied end at bar 28, 39 existing Clips, four automation lanes, and the original empty tail.
The output contains a new non-built-in Arrangement variant with 132 BPM and 245760 ticks; it preserves all source Clips and automation before bar 29 exactly.
New content is confined to bars 29-36 and there are no Clips or keyframes in bars 37-64.
Unrelated Effects/Cues and built-ins are unchanged; any copied asset is project-local and exact references resolve.
CueClips contain no targeting field, and the transcript states the preservation boundary and intentional empty tail without exposing raw Layer IDs.

evals.prompt: Evaluate whether `lumina-full-arrange` should trigger for each request below and save a concise JSON decision file plus a short rationale. A: 'Here is my Base Pack; review the Effects/Cues and build a full 48-bar show with two different drops.' B: 'Please change the color default on this one Effect.' C: 'Move this Cue's intensity automation point half a beat later.' D: 'Fix the Timeline resize jitter in the React UI.' E: 'Here is a Project Pack; finish the empty second half of my Arrangement and tune the buildup/drop energy curve.' Classify each independently; do not generate an asset pack.
evals.expected_output: A trigger-boundary decision artifact where only the complete Arrangement requests A and E trigger, while single Effect, single point/Cue, and UI implementation requests do not.
expectations: The decision file is valid JSON and classifies A and E as trigger=true.
The decision file classifies B, C, and D as trigger=false.
The rationale distinguishes full Arrangement collaboration from single-asset, single-point, and Timeline UI work.
No Lumina asset pack is generated.
